inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL date-function exercise applies ADDDATE with day, month, year, and hour interval units to a date column.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored release-window audit. Fixed DATETIME anchors exercise day, month, quarter, year, and hour ADDDATE intervals, including month-end clamping and SQL NULL propagation; the source table, rows, aliases, and application purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Release 301 starts on 2024-01-31 so month and quarter additions expose leap-year calendar clamping; release 302 crosses a year boundary; release 303 preserves SQL NULL through every ADDDATE projection.
determinism_notes: Release IDs, DATETIME anchors, and interval literals are fixed, and output is ordered by the primary key with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE release_windows (release_id INT PRIMARY KEY, release_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, anchor_at DATETIME NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT release_id, release_label, anchor_at, ADDDATE(anchor_at, INTERVAL 10 DAY) AS day_shift, ADDDATE(anchor_at, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS month_shift, ADDDATE(anchor_at, INTERVAL 1 QUARTER) AS quarter_shift, ADDDATE(anchor_at, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AS year_shift, ADDDATE(anchor_at, INTERVAL 10 HOUR) AS hour_shift FROM release_windows ORDER BY release_id
